name: Dogs
overview: The Bible references dogs in various contexts that reveal both their literal and symbolic roles. Scripture distinguishes the faithful from the unclean, as seen in Exodus 11:7 where dogs do not harm the Israelites, highlighting God's protection. Dogs are also portrayed negatively, symbolizing folly and wickedness, as in Proverbs 26:11 and Matthew 7:6, where they represent those who reject holiness and truth. Yet, Proverbs 12:10 acknowledges the righteous man's care for animals, demonstrating a God-honoring stewardship even over beasts.
